{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    n = 9
    g = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    # Place a compact 2x2 marker/object, with one cell colored 9.
    r = rng.randrange(1, 7)
    c = rng.randrange(1, 7)
    cells = [(r,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c),(r+1,c+1)]
    for rr,cc in cells:
        g[rr][cc] = 2
    # Keep the distinguished 9 in one of the four corners, while the others are 2.
    rr,cc = rng.choice(cells)
    g[rr][cc] = 9
    return g"}
